candidates.summary: Postgres shared state serializes authorization, inbox, idempotency, and claims across relay processes.
Session-only agent and relationship screens reuse the owner state machine and never reveal another member's identity.
One synthetic pull adapter verifies signatures, persists a shared inbox, ACKs, then claims before judgment.
Cleanup removes expired payloads and retained metadata even when no client polls.
Generate D08 directly from the committed SQL migration, preserving stamped metadata.
Member connections bind a short approval to one owner, agent, client and new key; only confirmed PoP creates credentials.
Package a standalone Cursor/Grok Bot plugin with a strict file allowlist and no credentials.
Package relay validates frozen relay.v1 and preserves one parsed object for signing and processing.
Prove product lint detects violations in temporary copies and propagates failure.
Registry exposes the central frozen seed; adding an intent never creates an execution handler.
